note: Frozen observational baseline, not an exemption list. New numerical gates remain disabled; do not refresh to hide debt.

contract.sources: all src/lua/**/*.lua; no exclusions; linked entries fail
contract.lines: physical lines including comments/blanks; terminal newline not an extra line
contract.functionSpan: inclusive AST span including nested bodies; all functions and main chunks
contract.functionIdentity: lexical parent/name/occurrence; correspondence is structural, not semantic proof
contract.sourceHash: sha256 UTF8 with CRLF normalized to LF
contract.complexity: Luacheck --max-cyclomatic-complexity 0 --only 561; one measurement per AST function/chunk
contract.cycles: all require edges including deferred; strongly connected components with internal edges
contract.warnings: exact file/line/column/code/message multiset; no relocation exemptions
